title: A box over zooms and keys with no clip in it keeps both picked
goal: On the timeline, a Shift box that adds a recording's keys to a zoom already picked (or one box that touches only zooms and keys) quietly drops the keys and keeps only the zooms, so the next move or delete leaves the keys behind. Whatever a box touches should stay picked together.
notes: Reproduced 2026-10-16 while working a-box-pick-on-the-timeline-is-copied-and-ripple, with Scripts/playtest/box-pick-copied-and-rippled-whole-walk.json reordered so the Zoom box came first: step 29 'dragTracks Zoom Tutorial Sample 0:01 to 0:04: picked Tutorial Sample zoom 1', step 30 'dragTracks Keys Tutorial Sample 0:00 to 0:03 (shift): picked Tutorial Sample zoom 1' (the keys at 1000 and 3000 ms were touched but not kept). Cause read in code: EditorState+TrackRange applyBoxPick with no clip picks calls pickBoxedZoomsOrKeys, which picks the zooms the way a click does and returns before the keys; boxExtras is only kept beside clips. Picking the title first keeps all of them (same walk as committed).
acceptance: A box on a recording's Zoom lane, then a Shift box on its Scale lane, leaves the zoom and both keys picked, and the panel says 3 picked
Dragging that pick or pressing Delete acts on the zoom and the keys together, each as one undo step
A walk at Next defaults reproduces it first and then passes

log.note: Reproduced on main f7afb552 with the new walk Scripts/playtest/box-over-zooms-and-keys-keeps-both-walk.json (first part): step 21 'dragTracks Keys Tutorial Sample 0:00 to 0:03 (shift): picked Tutorial Sample zoom 1'; step 23 expectTimelinePick FAILED, keys at 1000 and 3000 ms not kept. Pre-build review: Premiere/FCP keep everything a marquee touches; the gap beyond picking is that a pick with no clip has nothing to carry a drag by (beginBoxPickDrag needs a whole clip), and a key lane drag's release re-sends byMS 0 when the box pick carries the drag.

Fixed in EditorState+TrackRange: a box with no clip that touches zooms AND keys (or keys on several layers) is held whole as boxExtras with an empty owner (no layer, no pieces); boxExtrasHeld for that owner also needs no tracks, cut, clicked zoom or clicked keys in hand. Such a pick has no clip to carry it by, so beginBoxPickDrag now starts a BoxExtrasDrag of its own (clamped by boxExtrasRoom, one perform via shiftBoxExtras, keys renamed via noteBoxExtrasLanded); zoom and key drags route through update/commit/cancelBoxPickDrag; ZoomLane, key lanes and canvas draw it in the air. Also fixed: a key lane drag's release re-sent byMS 0 when a box pick carried the drag (KeyLanesView keyDrag onEnded now uses boxPickDragHandMS), which the new fourth walk test exercises.

left rough (log only, no task): Option while dragging a zooms+keys pick with no clip moves it rather than copying (copies only exist through the clip bar's drag); the right-click Delete Zoom on a lit bar still removes only zooms. Neither is broken behaviour a person hits in the asked flow, and no open task covers copying extras alone.

A box with no clip over a recording's zoom and keys keeps them all picked (panel: 3 picked, 1 zoom, 2 keys); Delete takes them as one step; dragging the zoom bar or a key carries the rest, one undo. EditorState+TrackRange/Zoom/KeyLanes, KeyLanesView. Verified: new walk box-over-zooms-and-keys-keeps-both-walk failed at step 23 before the fix and passes all 63 steps after, at Next defaults with real hand drags; 13 neighbouring box/zoom/key walks green; Scripts/test.sh 13313 tests green.
